// diagnostic

E1312

A call uses spread at a function with no variadic rest parameter.

What

A call uses spread at a function with no variadic rest parameter.

Why

`f(...xs)` only applies when the callee's final parameter is variadic (`name: ...T`).

Fix

Pass arguments individually, or call a function whose last parameter is variadic.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1312: tests/ui/spread_bad_call.stderr.

Error [E1312]: `fixed` doesn't accept a spread argument
  --> tests/ui/spread_bad_call.jet:7:5
    |
  7 |     fixed(...xs)
    |     ^^^^^
 Why: call spread `f(...xs)` only works when the callee has a final `...` rest parameter
 Fix: pass arguments individually, or call a function whose last parameter is variadic
